t: 罗伯特·卡维利埃·德·拉·萨勒发现了密西西比河口,为法国宣称并取名路易斯安那.
te: Robert Cavelier de La Salle discovers the mouth of the Mississippi River, claims it for France and names it Louisiana.
dz: 罗伯特·卡维利埃·德·拉·萨勒发现了密西西比河口,为法国宣称并取名路易斯安那.
de: Robert Cavelier de La Salle discovers the mouth of the Mississippi River, claims it for France and names it Louisiana.

t: 法国路易十四将宫廷迁至凡尔赛宫。
te: Louis XIV of France moves his court to the Palace of Versailles.
dz: 法国路易十四将宫廷迁至凡尔赛宫。
de: Louis XIV of France moves his court to the Palace of Versailles.

t: 威廉·潘恩接收了现在的特拉华州所在的地区,并添加到他的殖民地宾夕法尼亚.
te: William Penn receives the area that is now the state of Delaware, and adds it to his colony of Pennsylvania.
dz: 威廉·潘恩接收了现在的特拉华州所在的地区,并添加到他的殖民地宾夕法尼亚.
de: William Penn receives the area that is now the state of Delaware, and adds it to his colony of Pennsylvania.

t: 高尔主教学校(Bishop Gore School)是威尔士最古老的学校之一,是创办所.
te: Bishop Gore School, one of the oldest schools in Wales, is founded.
dz: 高尔主教学校(Bishop Gore School)是威尔士最古老的学校之一,是创办所.
de: Bishop Gore School, one of the oldest schools in Wales, is founded.

t: 费城成立于宾夕法尼亚联邦.
te: Philadelphia is founded in the Commonwealth of Pennsylvania.
dz: 费城成立于宾夕法尼亚联邦.
de: Philadelphia is founded in the Commonwealth of Pennsylvania.
